project_scope.note: B012 Central Texas elm set; Chinese elm is retained as introduced/invasive comparison and excluded from native totals.

priority: corky twig wings and whether they stop at nodes
study_strategy.warning: Do not identify elms from leaf shape alone. Cedar vs winged elm especially depends on wing behavior at nodes and reproductive season.

quick_key.if: small rough leaves + fall flowers/fruit + corky wings may continue around nodes
large asymmetric leaf + unwinged twig + spring samara with ciliate margin
mottled exfoliating bark + small glossy leaves + fall reproduction
